design_packet_ref.concern: Full Standard design: receipt schema delta, re-fire flow, circuit breaker (measured), adjudication call justification, slice horizon

material_concerns.summary: The existing --correction-mode block only forces one retry: learning_capture_hook.py unconditionally allows on a re-fired Stop event (stop_hook_active: true) regardless of whether the flagged problem was fixed.
material_concerns.resolution: Addressed directly in the design's section 3 re-fire flow: the re-fire path now checks for a compliant Learnings marker or a contest marker instead of blanket-allowing.

material_concerns.summary: Circuit-breaker attempt bound needed Brian's disposition, not a silently assumed default.
material_concerns.resolution: Brian disposed 2026-09-14: do not cap at 1 (too little signal for the tuning feedback loop he wants); start high and tune down from observed friction. Set to 3, the highest value the measured harness ceiling (section 4) actually allows to stay inside the design's own control rather than silently deferring to the harness.

material_concerns.summary: Whether Claude Code's own Stop-hook re-fire mechanism has an independent hard ceiling on repeated blocks was unverified.
material_concerns.resolution: Measured directly via an isolated test, reproduced on two independent runs: exactly 3 forced re-fires (4 Stop events total) before the harness gives up silently (clean exit 0, no error, no output). Recorded as lrn-20260914T174509317199Z-df8d944ad2.

next_slice_refs.concern: Slice 1 (fully_specifiable_now): schema extension + deterministic re-fire check, no LLM call, implementation-ready
